<entry id="C00544">
<head-word>גְּזִיזָא</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (גזז) 
<italic>cut off</italic>, whence </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>branch, club</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. 7
<sup>a</sup> אדייה לגְּזִיזֵיה וכ' lifted up his club and stood (against me; 
<pgbrk id="pg230" />Rashi: his 
<italic>fist</italic>). B. Kam. 5
<sup>a</sup> תבריה ר"ע לגזיזיה R. Akiba has broken the force of his club (Rashi: 
<italic>fist</italic>), i.e. modified his opinion; ib. 42
<sup>b</sup></notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>piece</italic>.</definition>
<notes> ג' דברדא 
<italic>a piece of ice</italic>. Targ. I Chr. XI, 22 תבר ג' דב' וכ' he cut a hole in the ice and bathed; Ber. 18
<sup>b</sup> גְּזִיזֵי.—
<plural-form>Pl. גְּזִיזֵי</plural-form>. Ib. 59
<sup>a</sup> גְּזִיזַיָּיה דברדא Ar. (ed. גזיזי דברזא) hail-stones (Ms. M. בְּזִיזַיָּה דנורא or בְּזָאַיָּה, Ms. F. גְּזִירֵי, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="C00545">

<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (גזז) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>shearing wool</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yalk. Num. 750 (Korah, beg.) זמן הג' (Midr. Till. to Ps. I זמן גיזה) the season of shearing. Ḥull. 135
<sup>a</sup> מחוסר ג' וכ' wants shearing, redemption &c. Gen. R. s. 74; s. 85; Midr. Sam. ch. XXIII כל מקום שנ' ג' וכ' wherever shearing is mentioned in biblical accounts, it marks (an important epoch).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (= חתיכה, v. 
<xref rid="C00544">preced.</xref>) 
<italic>piece, shred.</italic></definition>
<notes>
<italic>—</italic>
<plural-form>Pl. גְּזִיזוֹת</plural-form>. Y. Orl. III, 63
<sup>a</sup> top (in Chald. diction) what profit is it to him גזים גזיזית (read … זוֹת) to cut it into shreds?</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="C00549">
<head-word>גְּזֵילָה, </head-word>
<head-word>גְּזֵלָה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h. </language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="C00558">גָּזֵל</xref>,
<xref rid="A00083"> גְּזֵלָה; גזל)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>robbery, robbed object, illegitimate gain</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Kam. 98
<sup>b</sup> משלם כשעת הג' he must make retribution according to the value of the object at the time it was robbed. Y. ib. X, 7
<sup>b</sup> bot. ג' מפורסמת a well-known robbery or robbed object. Treat. S’maḥ. ch. IX מרובה גְזֵילַת המת וכ' severer is the crime of robbery (or wrong) committed against a dead person &c.—
<plural-form>Pl. גְּזֵילוֹת, גְּזֵלוֹת</plural-form>. Snh. I, 1 ג' וחבלות law-suits of larceny and mayhem. Gitt. 55
<sup>b</sup> that it may not be said מזבח אוכל ג' the altar receives illegitimately acquired goods; Y. ib. V, 47
<sup>b</sup> top.—Keth. 105
<sup>a</sup>; ib. XIII, 1 דייני ג' Y. ed. (Bab. גזירות) judges in suits of robbery; Bab. ib. 105
<sup>a</sup> (harmonizing the two versions) גוזרי גזירות על ג' decreeing fines in cases of robbery. [Targ. Cant. VI, 6 גְּזֵלָה a. גְּזֵילֹות h. forms.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="C00556">

<senses>

<notes /></sense>

<definition>
<italic>circumcision, foreskin</italic>, v. 
<xref rid="C00536">גְּזוּרְתָּא</xref>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. II Ex. IV, 25 sq. (some ed. גְּזֵירָ').</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>

<italic>decree, edict, ordinance</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Ex. V, 14 גְּזֵירַתְכוֹן your decreed task. Targ. I Kings X, 25 גְּזֵירַת וכ' the decreed (tax) of every year. Targ. O. Ex. I, 8; a. fr.—Gitt. 55
<sup>b</sup> ג' קמייתא the first (Roman) decree (after the capture of Jerusalem). Ab. Zar. 35
<sup>a</sup> כי גזרי ג' וכ' when they published a (religious) enactment in Palestine.—
<plural-form>Pl. גְּזֵירָתָא</plural-form>. Targ. Job XIV, 5.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="C00558">
<head-word>גָּזַל</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>to tear away, rob</italic> (with accus. of person or of object); 
<italic>to take illegitimately</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Kam. X, 5 הגּוֹזֵל שדה מ־ he who robs a field from his neighbor (takes forcible possession). Ib. 6 הגוזל את וכ' he who robs his neighbor (takes illegitimately what belongs to his neighbor). Ib. 7 גְּזַלְתִּיךָ I have wronged thee (and owe thee retribution). Ber. 35
<sup>b</sup> כאילו גוֹזֵל להקב"ה as though he robbed the Lord. Taan. 16
<sup>a</sup> ג' מריש ובנאו בבירה if one robbed a beam and placed it in a large building; a. v. fr.—
<italic>Part.</italic> גּוֹזֵל 
<italic>robber</italic>, pl. גּוֹזְלִין. Y. B. Bath. III, 14
<sup>a</sup> bot. האומנין והג' וכ' mechanics (who take working material to their homes) and robbers cannot claim the right of possession, v. חֲזָקָה.—
<italic>Part. pass.</italic> גָּזוּל 
<italic>robbed, illegitimately acquired</italic>. Succ. III, 1; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִגְזַל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be robbed</italic> (of object taken, or of person deprived).</definition>
<notes> B. Kam. 95
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. קרקע אינה נִגְזֶלֶת landed property cannot be robbed, i.e. can never become legitimate property by the law of limitation, v. יִאוּשׁ.—Part. נִגְזָל 
<italic>the person robbed</italic> of his property, 
<italic>claimant</italic>. Shebu. VII, 1; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="C00560">
<head-word>גָּזֵל, </head-word>
<head-word>גֶּזֶל</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h. </language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="unknown">גָּזֵל; גזל)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>robbery, wrong, oppression</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 32
<sup>b</sup> בעוון ג' וכ' as a punishment for the crime of oppression, the locust rises &c. (ref. to Am. IV, 1 a. 9). Gen. R. s. 31, beg. שׁטופים בזימה ובג' steeped in lust and violence. Pes. 113
<sup>b</sup> Canaan bequeathed to his sons … אהבו את הג' love ye violence. B. Kam. 80
<sup>b</sup> אין בו משום ג' the law of robbery does not apply to it (it is not private property). Erub. 100
<sup>b</sup> we should have learned ג' מנמלה the regard of property from the ant. B. Kam. 109
<sup>a</sup> עד שיוציא גְּזֵילוֹ וכ' until he dispossesses himself of his robbery. Ib. שיוציא גזילה (corr. acc.). Ib.
<sup>b</sup> גזילו יוצא וכ' his robbery must go 
<pgbrk id="pg231" />out of his possession. Y. B. Mets. II, 8
<sup>c</sup> גזילו של גוי וכ' what has been illegitimately taken from a gentile, is forbidden (must be restored). Y. Gitt. IV, 45
<sup>c</sup> מפני ג' השבט in order to protect the (priestly) tribe from loss; Y. Orl. II, 61
<sup>d</sup> bot. מפני גיל השבט (corr. acc.); a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="C00563">
<head-word>גַּזְלָן, </head-word>
<head-word>גּוֹזְלָן</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (גזל) 
<italic>robber</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Kam. 62
<sup>a</sup> (defin.) חמסן … ג' לא יהיב וכ' 
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>amsan</italic> (violent man) is one who (takes by force and) pays; 
<italic>gazlan</italic>—who takes without paying. Snh. 26
<sup>b</sup> ג' דאורייתא a robber in the strict (Biblical) sense; ג' דרבנן a robber in a wider (Rabbinical) sense, e.g. a gambler &c.; ib. 25
<sup>b</sup>.—Y. Snh. VIII, 26
<sup>b</sup> he who takes an object in the presence of witnesses is called thief (גַּנָּב), he who takes in the owner’s presence—ג' a robber; v. B. Kam. 79
<sup>b</sup>. Y. Kidd. II, 62
<sup>b </sup>bot. כל המשנה וכ' he who changes the use of a loaned object without the owner’s consent נקרא גו' is called a robber. Ib. I, 60
<sup>c</sup> top גו'; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. גַּזְלָנִים, גַּזְלָנִין, גּוֹזְלָ'</plural-form>. Snh. l. c. Ib. 38
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<italic>decree, edict, divine dispensation</italic>; (in an evil sense)

<sup>b</sup> to reflect איזו ג' קשה אביא וכ' what hard dispensation to send them; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>a rabbinical enactment issued as a guard</italic> (v.

<italic>preventive measure; in gen. prohibition, restriction</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Bath. 60
<sup>b</sup>, a. e. אין גוזרין ג' על וכ' we must not impose a restriction on the public which the majority can not endure. Bets. 2
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. ג' משום וכ' it is prohibited in order to prevent &c. Ib. 3
<sup>a</sup> ג' לג' a guard to a guard, i.e. a preventive measure enacted in order to prevent the violation of another preventive measure; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. גְּזֵרוֹת, גְּזֵירוֹת</plural-form>. B. Bath. l. c. ג' רעות וקשות Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) bad and severe enactments (persecutions). Sabb. 30
<sup>a</sup> Moses, our teacher גזר כמה ג' issued so many restrictions. Macc. 24
<sup>a</sup> ארבע ג' גזר וכ' four hardships did Moses pronounce over Israel. Erub. 21
<sup>b</sup> הרבה ג' גזרתי על עצמי וכ' many restrictions did I (Israel) impose upon myself beyond those which thou (the Lord, in the Torah) &c. Pes. 87
<sup>b</sup>, v. אֲרָם; a. fr.—M. Kat. III, 3, v. גָּזָר.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition> (logics) 
<italic>category</italic>, esp. ג' שָׁוָה 
<italic>G’zerah shavah, an equal or identic category</italic>, i.e. an analogy between two laws established on the basis of verbal congruities in the texts, e.g. Pes. 66
<sup>a</sup>, נאמר מועדו בפסח וכ' the Passover law contains the word 
<italic>moădo</italic> (due season, Num. XI, 2) and the law concerning the daily sacrifices uses the same word (ib. XXVIII, 2): as the word 
<italic>moădo</italic> in the latter indicates that it applies also to the Sabbath day (superseding the ordinary Sabbath law concerning labor), so does it in the former intimate that it supersedes the Sabbath law (if the eve of Passover occurs on a Sabbath).</definition>
<notes> Ib. אין אדם דן ג"ש מעצמו you cannot establish an analogy from congruent expressions of your own accord, i.e. it must be authorized by tradition that the verbal congruity is applied to a certain analogy and no other.—Y. Yeb. XI, 11
<sup>d</sup> top ג"ש במקום שבאת an analogy can be drawn wherever it occurs, i.e. a textual analogy once established must be carried through all details; ib. VIII, 9
<sup>c</sup> bot. ג"ש במקום 
<pgbrk id="pg233" />שכתוב (corr. acc.); Y. Kidd. IV, 65
<sup>d</sup> top; Y. Snh. IX, 26
<sup>d</sup> bot.; a. e.—Sabb. 97
<sup>a</sup> ג"ש לא גמיר he had no tradition concerning that analogy; a. fr.—In gen. ג"ש 
<italic>analogy</italic>. Bets. I, 6; a. e.—
<plural-form>Pl. גְּזֵירוֹת שָׁווֹת</plural-form>. Gen. R. s. 46; Lev. R. s. 25. [Y. Ber. VIII, 12
<sup>b</sup> top גזירה דהוא רבע, read גזרית or גזירנא I command that &c.; Y. Keth. V, 30
<sup>a</sup> גזירה דגזרין, v. גָּזוֹרָא.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>
